reason: The verification standard to check this change against: verify every finding against source, and treat under-claiming as the loop-ending failure. This task adds a gate, so the check must confirm it fires on the real 2026-08-06 collision rather than on a synthetic case that proves nothing.

Lets the check judge whether the pack-local rule was added to the right surface and whether the existing append-only and non-linear-commit rules still hold, since neither may be weakened to make room.
